title: The Rights of Children upon Their Parents
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين - عماد عبدالعظيم (الألوكة)

text_simplified: The text discusses the rights of children upon their parents and mentions a story about a child asking his father for something. It highlights the importance of fulfilling children’s needs and strengthening family communication.

review_defects.english: The Rights of Children upon Their Parents
review_defects.why: The Arabic 'الآباء' specifically means 'fathers', not 'parents' (which would be 'الوالدين' or 'الأبوين'). The English broadens the scope to include mothers, altering the intended meaning.
